agent_explanation: High-speed circle vs thin (0.2 thick) wall: despite 22 substeps per step, the body moves from grazing distance 0.023 at step 1 to 0.228 overlap at step 2 with vx identical (-49.99) and vy only changed by gravity, i.e. no contact impulse or positional correction was applied. Likely discrete collision detector misses thin-box contact at high tangential speed (corner/edge clipping) so overlap accumulates past 0.15 limit.
